messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — GPU queue growth detected for redwood-runtime-prod (threshold crossed). Severity: P1. Affected route: /v1/generate (latency 95p > 6s). Paging oncall.
oncall-jordan: got it, joining. seeing large backlog in the inference queue, autoscaler isn't adding nodes. digging in.
eng-sre-amy: I'm seeing repeated errors from cluster-autoscaler: `Failed to increase size for ASG gpu-pool: scaling activity not permitted: max size reached` then fallback retry logs.
infra-mike: confirm ASG for gpu-pool has max-size=8, current=8. Customer surge + normal traffic pushed beyond capacity.
runtime-lisa: traffic pattern shows a sudden embedded-batch spike ~10:12 UTC, token-per-request increased. KV cache hit-rate dropped, so per-request GPU time tripled.
oncall-jordan: any errors beyond max-size? kube events?
eng-sre-amy: kube events show `FailedCreatePod` for several inference pods: `no nodes available with required taints and resources` and cluster-autoscaler log: `Error: launch template version mismatch for nodegroup gpu-pool-ng`.
infra-mike: hmm launch template drift. Recent LT update last night (image patch) may have created a new version but ASG launch configuration still pointing to older one. autoscaler tries to provision and fails user-data/iam attach.
deploy-bot: deploy redwood-runtime-2026.03.15 completed 03:40 UTC to staging.
runtime-lisa: we rolled runtime config changes earlier in the week that require instance profile PassRole, did we change IAM? any denied logs?
eng-sre-amy: checking cloudtrail, I see repeated `iam:PassRole` denied when autoscaler attempts to create new nodes via managed nodegroup API: `User: arn:aws:sts::...:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler/... is not authorized to perform: iam:PassRole on resource: arn:aws:iam::...:role/gpu-node-role`.
oncall-jordan: so autoscaler can't create instances because of PassRole denied AND ASG at max-size. That's two blockers.
product-eli: customers complaining in support. Which customers affected? any paid tenants in Dedicated?
customer-sam: we're seeing elevated error rates for customer-42 and customer-93. Support has flagged 12 customers with 5xx spikes.
eng-sre-amy: mitigation plan: 1) quick increase ASG max-size by +3 while we sort IAM 2) manual nodegroup create as fallback 3) route heavy jobs to CPU fallback pool if possible.
infra-mike: increasing ASG max-size now, hitting cloud quota? requesting via console.
infra-mike: attempted to set max-size=11 -> API rejected: `Cannot modify: account EC2 quota for GPU instances (p3) exceeded`.
oncall-jordan: quota limit blocks bump. Next: create temporary CPU-backed instances to sweat some of the backlog by routing non-latency-critical jobs off GPU.
runtime-lisa: we can enable the routing rule to downgrade low-priority batches to CPU model-quantized. Doing a canary to 10%.
eng-sre-amy: temporarily cordon/taint nodes? we need nodes added that accept GPU pods. Manual node creation possible if IAM fixed.
infra-mike: investigating PassRole policy — looks like a permissions change in the cluster role last week: `cluster-autoscaler` role got scoped down in the cross-account role update. Rolling back to previous policy now.
oncall-jordan: rollback in progress. ETA ~5m.
eng-sre-amy: while rollback runs, I'm going to manually spin up a spot CPU nodepool and set pod affinity to let some work proceed. Command:

```
eksctl create nodegroup --cluster redwood-prod --name cpu-backfill --node-type c6i.large --nodes 4 --tags role=backfill
```

infra-mike: created cpu-backfill nodegroup (4 nodes). They joined the cluster. Pods started scheduling but many inference pods require GPU tolerations; runtime configured to accept CPU fallback for low-priority only.
runtime-lisa: routing rule applied: low-priority inference -> cpu-backfill. Queue draining for those jobs started. backlog reduced by ~30%.
eng-sre-amy: PassRole rollback completed. Testing autoscaler create: triggering test scale up.
eng-sre-amy: cluster-autoscaler logs now show `Successfully created 1 nodes for ASG gpu-pool` but then `Node created but failed to join due to taint mismatch: node has taint gpu=present:NoSchedule, pods require gpu=true`.
oncall-jordan: taint mismatch? Launch template userdata might set taint differently. Need to compare launch template versions.
infra-mike: the active launch template version for ASG is v7, the latest LT we push is v9. The ASG still references v7. New nodes created by autoscaler are using the ASG config which lacks the proper `kubelet-extra-args` to set taints, so pods can't schedule.
eng-sre-amy: workaround: remove taint requirement from the podSpec temporarily for critical inference pods (patch deployment). Doing patch for /v1/generate replicas.
runtime-lisa: patched Deployment inference-prod to tolerate nodes without taint — forcing them to accept GPU or CPU nodes if resources present. Risky but necessary.
product-eli: any customer-visible degradation left?
customer-sam: errors down from 5xx to ~1% for flagged customers, latency 95p still elevated ~3.8s vs 2s baseline. Customers notified via status page about partial degradation.
oncall-jordan: status page updated: partial degradation for generation endpoint, mitigation in progress. :warning:
eng-sre-amy: autoscaler now able to create nodes, but ASG capacity plus taint mismatch and quota made autoscale ineffective until we patched.
infra-mike: quota requests for additional GPU instances submitted to cloud support with urgency. Reference #CS-7291.
eng-sre-amy: I've removed the temporary pod patch and reapplied correct tolerations now that nodes come with correct taints. Observing normal scheduling.
oncall-jordan: backlog cleared to acceptable levels by 12:47 UTC. Marking mitigation achieved.
deploy-bot: auto-notify: oncall handoff at 13:00 UTC to eng-sre-amy.
eng-sre-amy: Handoff note for next shift: root cause likely a chain: LT drift (ASG referencing older LT) + recent IAM narrowing caused PassRole denial + account GPU quota at limit. Autoscaler couldn't create nodes or created incompatible nodes -> queue growth.
runtime-lisa: immediate post-incident actions: 1) add integration test that validates ASG LT versions match approved LT on deploys 2) add alert for iam:PassRole denies correlated with autoscaler activity 3) add fallback routing knob to throttle model size automatically when queue growth triggers and GPUs saturated.
infra-mike: infra follow-ups: 1) approve emergency GPU quota increase or reserve pre-warmed GPU capacity for burst 2) revert policy change that scoped cluster-autoscaler passrole until we transition to a least-privilege path with explicit tests.
product-eli: communications: send an incident summary to affected customers by EOD and include mitigation and timeline.
customer-sam: customer ops will coordinate the messages.
oncall-jordan: closing notes: incident resolved, postmortem scheduled tomorrow 09:30 UTC. If anybody has logs/notes to add, paste them here.
eng-sre-amy: attaching key log snippets:

```
cluster-autoscaler[...]: I0315 12:11:02.123456 scale_up.go:200] DoScaleUp: Attempting to increase ASG gpu-pool size from 8 to 9
aws-sdk: Error: RequestCanceled: request context canceled
cloudtrail: iam:PassRole Denied for arn:aws:sts::...:assumed-role/cluster-autoscaler
kubelet: Warning FailedTaint: Node has unexpected taint set: gpu=present:NoSchedule
```

eng-sre-amy: thanks everyone — handing off to AMY for follow-up. :white_check_mark:
oncall-jordan: thanks team. leaving notes in the incident tracker. :thumbsup:
